status: candidate; input mapping set by the user 2026-10-12

inputs.light: light attack: one key/button for the punch combo (jab, cross)
inputs.heavy: heavy attack: a separate key/button for the kick combo (low kick, snap kick, spin roundhouse)

rules: Light attack and heavy attack are two separate inputs, each bound to its own key/button.
One press plays one clip; every step of a chain needs its own press, in rhythm (inside the playing clip's chain window, its last two frames).
Punch combo: light, light = jab, cross.
Kick combo: heavy, heavy, heavy = low kick, snap kick, spin roundhouse.
Jab, cross, roundhouse: light, light, heavy. A heavy press in the cross's chain window plays the spin roundhouse finisher (the low and snap kicks are skipped).
Other mixes follow the sequences: each input keeps its own position for the life of the combo (for example light, heavy = jab, low kick; heavy, light = low kick, jab).
A press whose sequence is used up does nothing. The spin roundhouse is the finisher and ends the combo.
A clip that finishes with no press in its window returns to neutral and ends the combo; both sequence positions reset.
A press during a clip's active frame or later is buffered and taken at its chain window.
Every clip starts and ends in the orthodox guard, so any clip can follow any other without a transition frame.

transitions.rule: explicit next clip for a press in each clip's chain window (null: the press does nothing); from neutral light plays jab and heavy plays lowKick
